title: Unincumbered
summary: UNINCUM'BERED, adjective 1. Not incumbered; not burdened. 2. Free from any temporary estate or interest, or from mortgage, or other charge or debt; as an estate unincumbered with dower.

inlines.v: UNINCUM'BERED, adjective 1. Not incumbered; not burdened. 2. Free from any temporary estate or interest, or from mortgage, or other charge or debt; as an estate unincumbered with dower.
